title: NWSRFS Operational Hydrology Models (nwsrfs-hydro-models)
description: Fortran source code, R package (nwsrfsr), and Python package (nwsrfspy) for the National Weather Service River Forecast System (NWSRFS) operational hydrology models used at the Northwest River Forecast Center (SAC-SMA, SNOW-17, UNIT-HG, LAG-K, CHANLOSS, CONS_USE, and RSNWELEV).

creators.name: Walters, Geoffrey
creators.affiliation: NOAA National Weather Service, Northwest River Forecast Center
